page.layout: One page of text, title block centred at the top, followed by the heading of the work in the body. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The faint, blurred lines below the title are show-through from the reverse of the leaf and are not transcribed. The initial R is a large drop cap and is joined to the rest of the word. The heading line "ALBERTI KYPERI" is set in spaced capitals and is treated as a level 1 heading.
